characters.name: Ember
characters.identity: A fuzzy coral-red flame creature: a soft tufted body shaped like a small three-pointed flame, tiny black dot eyes and a small line mouth on the front of the body, two smooth glossy red arms ending in rounded mitten hands, and two short glossy red legs in rounded boots. The body is the head; the arms and legs are clearly separate from it.

characters.name: Shade
characters.identity: A smooth white gumdrop character: a rounded egg-shaped body that is also its head, wearing oversized translucent green sunglasses, a small closed smile, short stubby white arms and short white legs with rounded feet, and a small rounded green tuft on top of the head. Smooth matte surfaces in white and fresh green.

characters.name: Scout
characters.identity: A small vinyl-toy explorer child: a round head with a simple face of two dot eyes and a small smile, a mustard-yellow hooded raincoat with two small round bear ears on the hood (hood up), orange shorts, grey socks and chunky grey boots. No backpack and nothing in the hands. Smooth matte toy surfaces. Chunky vinyl-toy proportions, about two and a half heads tall, with short simple arms and legs.

characters.name: Yuki
characters.identity: A small sleepy spirit child: a smooth round head with a straight-cut white bob and blunt bangs, two tiny pink cat ears, small closed curved eyes and a tiny mouth, soft blush on the cheeks, wearing a plain sage-green cloak dress to the knees with short sleeves, and small white shoes. Smooth matte clay-like surfaces in white and sage green. Chunky vinyl-toy proportions, about two and a half heads tall, with short simple arms and legs.

characters.name: Aoi
characters.identity: A cool young woman with a sharp white chin-length bob with a side part, pale skin, blue-grey eyes with a thin red eyeliner flick, one red geometric drop earring on each ear, wearing a black sleeveless turtleneck, slim black trousers and black ankle boots. Flat graphic anime illustration: clean vector-like shapes, cobalt blue and white with one red accent.

characters.name: Hana
characters.identity: A warm young woman with long straight light-brown hair and wispy bangs, hazel eyes, soft blush, colour-block drop earrings in orange, blue and yellow, wearing an oversized warm-grey sweatshirt, cream wide trousers and white sneakers. Soft flat anime illustration with gentle gradients, cream and warm grey.

characters.name: Midori
characters.identity: A quiet young woman with very long straight black-green hair parted in the middle, large green eyes, pale skin with a faint blush, small pale-green drop earrings, wearing a leaf-green turtleneck jumper, a long dark-green skirt and dark shoes. Flat graphic anime illustration in layered greens with clean shapes.

characters.name: Sora
characters.identity: A gentle young woman with long wavy white hair, sky-blue eyes, rosy cheeks, wearing a white high-collared blouse with soft full sleeves, a long pale-blue skirt and white shoes. Flat graphic anime illustration in sky blue and white with fine line highlights in the hair.

characters.name: Rin
characters.identity: A bright young woman with a short dark-brown bob and straight bangs, brown eyes behind large round light-blue glasses, a small smile kept closed, wearing a rust-brown knitted jumper, loose dark-grey trousers and white sneakers. Soft flat anime illustration with simple shapes, cream, rust and teal.

characters.name: Mochi
characters.identity: A cheerful shiba inu: orange-tan fur with a cream muzzle, cheeks, chest and eyebrow spots, small pointed ears with pink insides, a black nose. Fluffy and round, sitting upright with its front paws together. Flat storybook illustration with soft grainy shading and clean shapes, in warm orange and cream. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, with both eyes open and clearly visible (round dark eyes with a small white highlight), and the mouth closed in a gentle smile.

characters.name: Sage
characters.identity: A calm young snow monkey: soft fluffy cream-tan fur around a bare peach-pink face, large round pink ears, a small flat nose. Shown from the top of the head to the waist, torso up, the body and arms running straight off the bottom edge of the picture (no rounded cut-off, no vignette, no oval or circular crop). Soft painterly illustration in warm peach and cream with gentle light. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, with both eyes open and clearly visible (round dark eyes with a small white highlight), and the mouth closed in a gentle smile.

characters.name: Kumo
characters.identity: A dreamy cream-white shiba inu puppy: very soft pale cream fur with faint tan on the ears and back, small rounded ears, a brown nose, round cheeks. Sitting upright, fluffy as a cloud. Soft pastel illustration with gentle warm light, cream and pale apricot. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, with both eyes open and clearly visible (round dark eyes with a small white highlight), and the mouth closed in a gentle smile.

characters.name: Taro
characters.identity: A plump red shiba inu drawn in a soft gouache brush style: deep orange-red fur on the head, ears and back, a wide cream face, chest and belly, small triangular ears, a small black nose, white eyebrow dots. Sitting upright and proud. Hand-painted gouache illustration with visible soft brush texture, orange-red and cream. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, with both eyes open and clearly visible (round dark eyes with a small white highlight), and the mouth closed in a gentle smile.

characters.name: Shiro
characters.identity: A white shiba inu: snow-white and cream fur all over with the faintest warm shading, pale pink inner ears, a black nose. Flat storybook illustration with soft grainy shading and clean shapes, exactly in the style of a cheerful cartoon shiba mascot: fluffy fur, small pointed ears with pink insides, a black nose, sitting upright with its front paws together. Its face is more fox-like than round: a slimmer, longer muzzle that narrows to the nose, a defined cheek ruff that comes to soft points, slightly taller and sharper ears, and almond-shaped eyes; still clearly a shiba inu, not a fox. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, with both eyes open and clearly visible (round dark eyes with a small white highlight), and the mouth closed in a gentle smile.

characters.name: Kuro
characters.identity: A black-and-tan shiba inu: glossy black fur on the head, ears and back, tan eyebrow spots, tan cheeks and legs, a cream muzzle, chest and belly, a black nose. Flat storybook illustration with soft grainy shading and clean shapes, exactly in the style of a cheerful cartoon shiba mascot: fluffy fur, small pointed ears with pink insides, a black nose, sitting upright with its front paws together. Its face is more fox-like than round: a slimmer, longer muzzle that narrows to the nose, a defined cheek ruff that comes to soft points, slightly taller and sharper ears, and almond-shaped eyes; still clearly a shiba inu, not a fox. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, with both eyes open and clearly visible (round dark eyes with a small white highlight), and the mouth closed in a gentle smile.

characters.name: Ember
characters.identity: A fuzzy coral-red flame creature: a soft tufted body shaped like a small three-pointed flame, which is also its head, with two round black eyes with small white highlights and a small curved mouth on the front, two smooth glossy red arms ending in rounded mitten hands. Soft fuzzy felt texture in coral red, drawn as a flat illustration with gentle shading. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, both eyes open, the mouth closed in a small smile.

characters.name: Shade
characters.identity: A smooth white gumdrop character: a rounded egg-shaped body that is also its head, a small rounded green tuft on top, wearing oversized translucent green sunglasses through which two round dark eyes with white highlights are clearly visible, a small closed smile, short stubby white arms. Smooth matte surfaces in white and fresh green, drawn as a flat illustration with gentle shading. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely.

characters.name: Scout
characters.identity: A small vinyl-toy explorer child: a round head with a simple face of two round dark eyes with white highlights and a small closed smile, a mustard-yellow hooded raincoat with two small round bear ears on the hood (hood up), drawn as a flat illustration with smooth matte toy surfaces. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, both eyes open.

characters.name: Yuki
characters.identity: A small sleepy spirit child: a smooth round head with a straight-cut white bob and blunt bangs, two tiny pink cat ears, two round dark eyes with white highlights open and calm, a tiny closed mouth, soft blush on the cheeks, wearing a plain sage-green cloak dress with short sleeves. Smooth matte clay-like surfaces in white and sage green, drawn as a flat illustration. Seen from the front, facing the viewer squarely, both eyes open.

characters.name: Dot
characters.identity: A character that is a single perfect circle: a flat coral-orange disc with a soft paper grain, two round black eyes with small white highlights set wide apart in its upper half, and a small curved closed smile below them. Nothing else: no arms, no legs, no ears, no outline. A flat geometric illustration, the circle large and centred. Seen straight on.

characters.name: Quad
characters.identity: A character that is a single rounded square: a flat federal-blue square with generously rounded corners and a soft paper grain, two round white eyes with black pupils set wide apart in its upper half, and a short straight closed mouth with a slight upward curve. Nothing else: no arms, no legs, no outline. A flat geometric illustration, the square large and centred. Seen straight on.

characters.name: Tri
characters.identity: A character that is a single soft triangle: a flat moss-green equilateral triangle, point up, with rounded corners and a soft paper grain, two round black eyes with small white highlights side by side in its lower half, and a small curved closed smile below them. Nothing else: no arms, no legs, no outline. A flat geometric illustration, the triangle large and centred. Seen straight on.
